learned_recency_decay.scientific_hypothesis: A predeclared exponentially decayed player outcome history can improve the per-PA categorical distribution relative to equal-weight historical counts, while the league prior and locked opportunity arm remain unchanged.

plate_discipline_information.scientific_hypothesis: Pitch-level plate-discipline information may improve strikeout and walk outcome probabilities.
plate_discipline_information.reason: The authorized release retains official final batting outcomes but not point-in-time pitch-level discipline receipts. Reusing final outcomes as a separate discipline block would duplicate C0 outcome counts rather than add an independent feature.

compressed_expected_stat_contact.scientific_hypothesis: A compact expected-stat contact-quality block may improve hit and extra-base outcome probabilities.
compressed_expected_stat_contact.reason: No immutable point-in-time Statcast feature receipts are contained in the authorized release; mutable data/savant/stats.csv is explicitly excluded.

raw_ev_launch_angle_contact_quality.scientific_hypothesis: Raw batted-ball exit velocity and launch angle may improve contact-outcome probabilities.
raw_ev_launch_angle_contact_quality.reason: No immutable point-in-time raw pitch-level Statcast history is contained in the authorized release.

park_effects.scientific_hypothesis: A source-bound, pregame-valid park context could improve hit, home-run and total-base probabilities.
park_effects.reason: The authorized release does not retain venue/park-factor source receipts. Static local park configuration is not a qualified replacement.

sprint_speed.scientific_hypothesis: Point-in-time sprint-speed information may improve hit-on-ball-in-play and extra-base distributions.
sprint_speed.reason: The authorized release contains no point-in-time sprint-speed source receipt.
